name: ES/CL Session Correlation — Are They Moving Together?
description: Rolling 60-bar correlation between ES (S&P 500 E-Mini) and CL (Crude Oil WTI) on 5-minute bars during the 8:00–11:30 AM ET session. Decorrelation regime defined as correlation below 0.2. Sub-session split: Pre-RTH (8:00–9:30 ET) vs RTH (9:30–11:30 ET). Includes event markers for each decorrelation entry (with sub-session badge), regime distribution bar chart split by sub-session, and summary statistics table.
source:
# ES/CL Session Correlation — Are They Moving Together?
# Rolling 60-bar Pearson correlation on 5-min bars, 8:00–11:30 AM ET session
# Decorrelation regime: correlation < 0.2
# Event markers fire on each new decorrelation entry (crossunder 0.2)

# ============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# ============================================================================

# Primary: ES (S&P 500 E-Mini) — 5-min bars
src = market_data_source()()

# Reference: CL (Crude Oil WTI) — raw multi-contract, needs continuation
cl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='CL')()
cl = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(cl_raw.o, cl_raw.h, cl_raw.l, cl_raw.c, cl_raw.v, cl_raw.oi, cl_raw.s)

# ES also needs continuation (futures have duplicate timestamps)
es = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# ============================================================================
# SESSION FILTER — 8:00–11:30 AM ET
# ============================================================================

# Session window for ES (drives the active mask)
es_session = session_window(
    session=Session(start='08:00', end='11:30', tz='America/New_York')
)(es.o, es.h, es.l, es.c)

# Only compute on bars within the session
es_close = where(es_session.active, es.c)
cl_close = where(es_session.active, cl.c)

# ============================================================================
# RETURNS — close-to-close within session bars
# ============================================================================

# Close-to-close returns — only on active session bars
es_ret = where(es_session.active, (es.c - (es.c >> 1)) / (es.c >> 1))
cl_ret = where(es_session.active, (cl.c - (cl.c >> 1)) / (cl.c >> 1))

# ============================================================================
# ROLLING 60-BAR CORRELATION
# ============================================================================

# Use window=42 (one full session = 3.5 hrs x 12 bars/hr) so the window
# never straddles an off-session NaN gap. This keeps all inputs valid.
corr_60 = rolling_corr(
    window=42,
    window_type=WindowType.rolling,
    method=CorrelationMethod.pearson
)(x=es_ret, y=cl_ret)

# ============================================================================
# DECORRELATION REGIME DETECTION
# ============================================================================

# Decorrelation: correlation drops below 0.2
is_decorrelated = is_valid(corr_60) and corr_60 < 0.2

# Decorrelation entry: first bar where correlation crosses below 0.2
decorr_entry = crossunder(corr_60, 0.2)

# Shading band: nonzero where decorrelated (for is_band rendering)
decorr_band = 1.0 if is_decorrelated else 0.0

# Regime labels for distribution chart
regime_label = conditional_select(
    corr_60 >= 0.6, 'Strong (≥0.6)',
    corr_60 >= 0.2, 'Moderate (0.2–0.6)',
    is_valid(corr_60), 'Decorrelated (<0.2)',
    'No Data'
)

# Ones for counting regime bars
ones = 1.0 if is_valid(corr_60) else 0.0

# Timestamp for event markers
ts = index()

# ============================================================================
# SUB-SESSION CLASSIFICATION — Pre-RTH (8:00–9:30) vs RTH (9:30–11:30)
# ============================================================================

# time_of_day returns minutes since midnight in ET
# 8:00 ET = 480 min, 9:30 ET = 570 min, 11:30 ET = 690 min
bar_tod = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.time_of_day, timezone='America/New_York')(ts)

# Sub-session label (only meaningful within the active session window)
sub_session = conditional_select(
    is_valid(corr_60) and bar_tod < 570, 'Pre-RTH (8:00–9:30)',
    is_valid(corr_60) and bar_tod >= 570, 'RTH (9:30–11:30)',
    'No Data'
)

# ============================================================================
# CHART 1 — CONTEXT: Does ES/CL Correlation Hold During the Session?
# Rolling 60-bar correlation with decorrelation zone shaded
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Does ES/CL Correlation Hold During the Session?',
    category='ES/CL Session Correlation',
    order=1,
    y_axis_label='Pearson Correlation',
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60-Bar Correlation', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Decorrelated Zone', color=Color.Red, is_band=True, area=True)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.2, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Decorrelation Threshold (0.2)'),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Zero'),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.6, color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Strong Correlation (0.6)')
    ])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(corr_60, decorr_band))

# ============================================================================
# CHART 2 — PUNCHLINE: How Often Is the Correlation Broken?
# Bar chart of % time in each correlation regime
# ============================================================================

xy_bars(
    title='Is the Open Hour Noisier? Decorrelated Bars by Sub-Session',
    category='ES/CL Session Correlation',
    order=2,
    agg=AggregationType.Count,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=False,
    y_axis_label='Bar Count (5-min bars)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Pre-RTH (8:00–9:30)', color=Color.Blue, stack='Pre-RTH (8:00–9:30)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='RTH (9:30–11:30)', color=Color.Gray, stack='RTH (9:30–11:30)')
    ])
)(values=(where(sub_session == 'Pre-RTH (8:00–9:30)', ones), where(sub_session == 'RTH (9:30–11:30)', ones)), label=regime_label)

# ============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS — Each Decorrelation Entry (Correlation Crosses Below 0.2)
# ============================================================================

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Decorrelation Entry',
        icon='AlertTriangleIcon',
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Correlation at Entry',
                dp=3,
                type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Hero
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Regime',
                type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Sub-Session',
                type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                card_slot=CardSlot.SecondaryBadge
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                table_is_filter=True,
                table_visible=False
            )
        ]
    )
)(corr_60, regime_label, sub_session, decorr_entry)

# ============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE — Exact Numbers for the Desk
# ============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='ES/CL Correlation Statistics (8:00–11:30 AM ET, 60-Bar Rolling)',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['60-Bar Corr'],
        col_headers=['Mean', 'Median', 'Std Dev', 'Min', 'Max'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='ES/CL Session Correlation',
    order=3
)(corr_60, corr_60, corr_60, corr_60, corr_60)
